profile.legal_name: Corey Barton Homes, Inc. (d/b/a CBH Homes)
markets: Boise / Treasure Valley (Ada and Canyon counties)
profile.org_note: Single-state, founder-owned builder. Owner/President Corey Barton runs it with Vice President Ronda Conger, who oversees operations, sales, marketing and culture. The company publishes no regional or division layer and no land or finance department heads. Barton is the public face of land deals (the Radiance master plan, the 2021 state land auction). Katie Miller (Land Development Manager) handles entitlements. The only named CFO, Serena Clark, appears in an undated BBB listing.
profile.summary: Idaho's largest homebuilder, founded 1992 by Corey Barton, 30,000+ homes built, spec-only since 2016, building in 13 southern Idaho cities. Vertically integrated through owner-affiliated sister companies (Builders Interiors, Icon Air, Icon Electric, Vertical Components truss plant, Proximity rentals/property management) and moving into a 214,000 sq ft Caldwell HQ in 2027. Its land pipeline now includes Radiance, a proposed ~1,200-acre, 6,800-unit Ada County master plan on land largely owned by Dennis Baker-controlled entities.

people.note: Founder (1992) and owner; Builder 100 firm page lists the CEO slot as "Corey Barton; Ronda Conger".
